Support ticket triage is often a bottleneck.

In many teams, an incoming email sits in an inbox until someone manually checks it, reads it, decides who should handle it, and forwards it along.

Compare that to a system where incoming tickets are tagged by keyword, assigned to the right person based on availability, and given a priority score in seconds.

The difference isn't just speed. It's the mental energy saved by your support team before they even write a reply.
